text:
dara: noticing spike in 504s from eu-west1 inference pool since 01:02 UTC. suspect prefix-cache allocation tweak in v3.2.1. proposing small revert image registry.redwood/inference:v3.2.1-lifeboat. Request expedited canary + rollforward if green.
hiro: paste a short log snippet and rollback steps pls. Also propose canary size.
dara: logs:
```
2026-03-24T01:03:10Z inference-1 error: prefix_cache alloc over cap -> reclaim -> timeout 504
2026-03-24T01:03:11Z inference-1 warn: upstream closed while streaming
```
image: registry.redwood/inference:v3.2.1-lifeboat
rollback: pin to v3.2.0, cordon & drain new nodes, redeploy. runbook RB-349.
hiro: recommend 2 canary pods in eu-west1, 12m watch, then 50% for 8m. disable autoscaler on canary, set mem limit back to 7Gi.
sam: CI smoke ok on image. I approve canary.
oncall-bot: @dara assigned to oncall until 2026-03-24T05:00Z. Alerts enabled: high-5xx-rate, node-mem.
deploybot: deploy requested by dara -> eu-west1 canary (2 pods) image registry.redwood/inference:v3.2.1-lifeboat. Observing 12m.
(deploybot) 01:14 UTC: canary 2/2 ready, healthchecks OK, 5xx trending down.
dara: good. monitoring p95/p99.
hiro: 12m done, looks stable. authorize ramp to 50%. +1 SRE.
deploybot: ramping to 50% for 8m.
01:25 UTC deploybot: 8m observation complete. 5xx down ~90%, latency stable, no new OOMs.
sam: proceeding to full rollout for eu-west1 with 10m final watch.
hiro: standing by for quick rollback if needed.
deploybot: full rollout complete. image: registry.redwood/inference:v3.2.1-lifeboat. No alerts during watches.
dara: added postmortem task to RB-349 to add integration test for prefix-cache changes. Marking thread resolved when changelog published.
